comparison.objective: Break and recover four insert tangs; record safely assembles a grinding-wheel stack onto a spindle.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a coaxial impact mandrel and hammer; record inspects/selects a wheel, aligns multiple rings and flanges, threads a nut, and regulates clamp torque.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contained fractures without insert/shell damage; record requires correct stack order, no damaged wheel, bounded tightening, successful brake-spin and pull tests. Candidate quantitative fracture/damage limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Both involve axial tool/part alignment, but wheel-stack assembly and torque verification do not test contact-driven fracture or fragment containment.
